newsitem.title: CHINA: Record year for China stock listings in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Record year for China stock listings in 1996.

text.p: This year was a record year for new listings of companies on China's two stock markets, with a 1996 total of 201 listed as of December 25, the China Securities newspaper said on Thursday.

Of this figure, 101 listed in Shenzhen and 100 in Shanghai, taking the total of listed companies in the two markets to 524, with a total share capitalisation of nearly 110 billion yuan, of which 34 billion was tradeable, it said.

Of the new listed companies, a higher proportion than before came from the poorer central and western regions of China, with 10 from Sichuan, four each from Xinjiang and Gansu, three each from Inner Mongolia and Qinghai and two each from Ningxia and Tibet, the newspaper said.
The pace of listings accelerated during the year, with 17 in the first quarter, 38 in the second quarter, 60 in the third and more than 80 in the fourth quarter, it said. It gave no more details.
